sources.title: Ciudades en las que DiDi está disponible
sources.proves: Official DiDi driver city directory explicitly lists Cancún, Chetumal and Campeche. Searches of the same directory found no entries for Playa del Carmen, Cozumel, Puerto Morelos, Isla Mujeres, Holbox or Tulum.

sources.title: Portal Estadístico
sources.publisher: Administración Portuaria Integral de Quintana Roo (APIQROO)
sources.proves: Official port-statistics system and year selector for route-passenger and cruise records.

sources.title: Ruta de pasajeros Cozumel 2025
sources.proves: 2025 Cozumel federal passenger-route totals: 1,932,907 entries, 1,920,863 exits, 3,853,770 total passenger movements; monthly low 246,590 in September and high 385,338 in August.

sources.title: Ruta de pasajeros Isla Mujeres 2025
sources.proves: 2025 Isla Mujeres federal passenger-route totals: 2,703,490 entries, 2,754,814 exits, 5,458,304 total passenger movements; monthly low 344,021 in September and high 551,255 in July.

sources.title: Ruta de pasajeros Chetumal 2025
sources.proves: 2025 Chetumal federal passenger-route totals: 11,796 entries, 13,276 exits, 25,072 total passenger movements; monthly low 1,136 in June and high 3,325 in January. It is a port aggregate and is not allocated here to a single destination.

sources.title: Cruceros Cozumel 2025
sources.proves: Cozumel recorded 1,300 cruise calls and 4,732,250 cruise passenger visits in 2025; monthly passenger low 258,399 in September and high 571,791 in December. This is context, not ferry-route demand.

sources.title: Chetumal — El Puerto
sources.proves: Chetumal is an official port with waiting room, parking and services; links the two Belize passenger operators; embedded official location centers on 18.4918983, -88.2996736.

sources.title: APIQROO ports navigation
sources.proves: Official APIQROO navigation separately identifies Puerto Juárez, Chetumal, Cozumel, Isla Mujeres, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Morelos and Bacalar port pages.

sources.title: Fares
sources.proves: Current published one-way adult fares: Playa del Carmen–Cozumel MXN 320 premium-plus, MXN 190 Quintana Roo resident, MXN 100 local; Puerto Juárez–Isla Mujeres MXN 290 premium-plus, MXN 100 Quintana Roo resident, MXN 55 local. Page identifies route terminals and links map locations.

sources.title: Routes and departures
sources.proves: Ultramar currently publishes departures for Playa del Carmen–Cozumel and Puerto Juárez–Isla Mujeres, confirming scheduled service. The page did not expose a durable source date in extraction.

sources.title: Schedules
sources.proves: Winjet publishes the Playa del Carmen–Cozumel scheduled crossing, corroborating a second current operator.

sources.title: Chetumal
sources.publisher: San Pedro Belize Express Water Taxi
sources.proves: Operator sells Chetumal–San Pedro international ferry service; page lists 10:00 departure, 1 hour 30 minute duration, and one-way prices of MXN 1,340 standard and MXN 1,050 Mexican citizen.

sources.title: Tráfico de pasajeros
sources.proves: Official gateway to ASUR airport passenger-traffic workbook.

sources.title: Tráfico de pasajeros ASUR workbook
sources.proves: 2025 total passengers: Cancún International 29,345,538 and Cozumel International 646,606. These are broad airport flows, not water-route demand.

sources.title: Lerma
sources.proves: Official Lerma port page describes PEMEX fuel facilities, fishing-vessel repair, medium-height vessels and fuel suppliers; it does not identify a passenger ferry terminal or scheduled passenger route.

sources.title: Marina El Cid Cancún–Riviera Maya
sources.proves: An operating marina exists at Puerto Morelos. It does not by itself prove scheduled passenger service or a DiDi city footprint.

sources.title: Holbox ferry rates and departures timetable
sources.proves: A current Chiquilá–Holbox ferry market exists. It does not prove DiDi operates in either Chiquilá or Holbox.

partner_narrative_notes.proposed_partner_narrative: DiDi can anchor the confirmed Cancún road leg into a measured water network: Puerto Juárez–Isla Mujeres carried 5.46 million passenger movements in 2025, while the adjacent Playa del Carmen–Cozumel channel carried 3.85 million. Start with an exact, BP-grounded Cancún island crossing; treat Playa–Cozumel as an adjacent market opportunity until local DiDi coverage and canonical berths are verified. Chetumal is a separate backlog expansion: DiDi is officially listed there and an international passenger port already links to Belize, but Atlas IDs and route geometry are not ready.
approved_claims: DiDi's official Mexico city directory lists Cancún, Chetumal and Campeche.
APIQROO recorded 5,458,304 Isla Mujeres passenger-route movements and 3,853,770 Cozumel passenger-route movements in 2025.
Puerto Juárez–Isla Mujeres has an exact existing Atlas route and verified BPs.
Playa–Cozumel is current scheduled ferry service, but its Atlas route is hidden pending berth resolution.
Chetumal has an official passenger port and operator-sold Belize service; it is backlog, not display-ready.
claims_to_soften_or_remove: 'DiDi operates throughout Cancún and the Riviera Maya' — official evidence found only an explicit Cancún listing, not Playa del Carmen, Cozumel or Puerto Morelos.
'No queue' — no operational evidence supports guaranteed queue elimination.
'No new infrastructure' — berth, charging, permits and terminal-interface needs must be scoped.
'Hemisphere's busiest' or 'heavily congested' — use measured APIQROO volumes unless a ranking/queue source is added.
Holbox and outer-reef direct routes — retain as future concepts only after BP, geometry, range and DiDi footprint checks.
